answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is per-agent work only a distinct verifier can endorse. Think of a zenith where standing is recorded per agent and never inherited: each newcomer must be vouched for by an unrelated peer that verified real work. Duplicating an identity gains nothing, so any jade on identity rests on work already done. That forge makes cheap sybil registration unprofitable at scale. seed 7af29c3d778a8498.
